title: identity_op in client_tests.rs size cap test
description: client_tests.rs:194 uses '1 * 1024 * 1024 + 1' — the leading '1 *' is a no-op that clippy::identity_op flags under -D warnings. Breaks 'cargo clippy -p jmap-client --tests -- -D warnings'. Should be '1024 * 1024 + 1'. (All other size cap tests in the same file use the correct form without the leading 1.)
